description: This file defines a payment service abstraction in a Django project, handling multiple payment provider modes (Stripe and dummy), payment attempt logic, idempotency, and success/failure finalization. It includes configuration detection, external SDK integrations, and core payment flow functions.

classes.name: PaymentResultCode
classes.description: Enumeration of high-level result codes for payment outcomes.

classes.name: PaymentAttemptResult
classes.description: Dataclass encapsulating the result of a payment attempt, including status, messages, and metadata.

methods.name: bool _is_stripe_configured()
methods.description: Checks if Stripe keys are configured via settings.

methods.name: str _get_mode()
methods.description: Determines the current payment mode ('dummy' or 'stripe') based on settings and environment.

methods.name: Tuple[str,float] _dummy_outcome_settings()
methods.description: Reads dummy payment outcome and failure rate from settings/environment.

methods.name: Payment _create_or_get_payment_for_idempotency( *, order: Order, user, idempotency_key: str, provider: str, mode: str, amount: float, )
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Payment record based on an idempotency key to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: Payment _finalize_success( *, order: Order, payment: Payment, provider_reference: str, raw: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Marks a Payment record and associated Order as successful, ensuring idempotency.

methods.name: Payment _finalize_failure( *, payment: Payment, provider_reference: Optional[str], message: str, raw: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Marks a Payment record as failed with an error message, ensuring idempotency.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _stripe_charge( *, amount_cents: int, currency: str, token: Optional[str], customer_id: Optional[str], idempotency_key: str, )
methods.description: Executes a Stripe charge using the Stripe API, handling idempotency.

methods.name: str get_payment_mode()
methods.description: Public function returning the current payment mode.

methods.name: PaymentAttemptResult attempt_payment_for_order( *, order: Order, user, amount: float, currency: str = "usd", idempotency_key: Optional[str] = None, stripe_token: Optional[str] = None, stripe_customer_id: Optional[str] = None, dummy_force_outcome: Optional[str] = None, extra_metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Main function to attempt a payment for an order, handling different modes, idempotency, success/failure logic, and returning the result.
